inherits_operational_gate.meaning: The historical v3 decision is preserved as a priority score. A v3 failure is never converted into absence.

rationale: Public official surface CT commonly contains 65 planes, about 156 um at 2.4 um/voxel.
Requiring a fixed 240 um window sent every valid official control to Tier C even when all available planes were present.
The supported-window policy measures on the largest symmetric physical window present in the source, never below 64 um.
central_slice_zero_distance_ratio is a localization diagnostic, not proof that CT bytes or surface support are missing.
non_claims: not accepted ink, text, letters, or First Letters
Tier B is a human-review queue, not a positive prediction
Tier C requests more support and is not evidence of absence
V1 remains an immutable terminal failed evaluation
